name: acmelabs-brain
description: The brain plugin on its own — install from this repo without the ACMElabs marketplace

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Keeps a repo's session log — the record of every commit that reached main and the story around it — through three acts: /brain:session start creates a session from a description, /brain:session log records a commit and updates what it made stale, /brain:session close finishes a session and its plan part; a tool gates every commit against the log and scaffolds the docs a repo needs. The one plugin that carries the whole toolset (ADR-002): every skill, command, agent and reference Peter works with, as brain:<name>.
